title: fix(console, auth): one me/localization and a parse-time cookie session check on a cold load
body:
Refs #35455

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：首次在新设备打开控制台（尤其托管环境）时，少等一次服务器往返，"语言与地区"信息只向服务器要一次；页面内容和登录行为不变。
- 为什么做：托管环境打开页面要 9–10 秒，云端的提速工作在等这一步；这是首屏串行请求专题的第一片。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是首次打开时货币/时区格式晚一点出现，或登录状态需要多问一次服务器；直接撤回本次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Slice 1 of the card, under claim 7010912290 as amended by 7012236805: item 4, and item 2's get-session edge in the cold posture. Items 1 and 3 and the bundle -> packages -> ai/agents chain are out of this slice. Delay probes showed that chain is not a dependency (os-dev-report 7012178512).

1. **One `me/localization` per cold load (item 4).** On a device's first visit, `seedTenantLanguage()` asks the endpoint before React mounts, and the request usually settles inside its 500 ms race. `LocalizationFetchProvider` mounts later, inside the app route. `sharedGetJson` shares only in-flight requests, so the provider asked a second time. The seed now holds its settled answer in a one-shot slot (`takeSettledSeedAnswer` in `languageSeed.ts`), keyed by the request (`inflightGetKey`) and the session-owner count. The provider's boot read takes it on its first attempt. The slot never holds an unauthenticated answer. An owner change answers `null`. The first take spends the slot whatever it finds, so a later mount and the re-read after a write to the user's own row ask the server. The seed rungs, the user's choice over the seed, stale-while-revalidate and the 500 ms race (ruling 6915665005, #5419 point 3) are untouched. On boots that already hold a seed, nothing changes: the seed does not fetch, and the provider revalidates as before.
2. **get-session no longer waits on the seed race when no Bearer is stored (item 2, cold posture).** `index.html`'s parse-time `startEarlySessionCheck` used to run only when a Bearer was stored. Without one, `AuthProvider` asked only after the mount, and the mount waits on `main.tsx`'s gate, which includes the seed race. The script now also asks the cookie session's question: the same URL and `credentials: 'include'`, with no `Authorization` header. `preflightAuth()` hands the answer on through the existing `objectui.authPreflightSession` slot with `token: null`. `takePreflightSession` takes a null-token slot only while no token is stored. A signed-out answer is handed on too, so `AuthProvider` settles signed out without asking again: a body naming no user, or the server's 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`. That 401 is what this server actually answers an anonymous `get-session` with (measured). A handed-on signed-out answer runs the same signed-out purge `loadSession` runs. The Bearer path is unchanged: a stale Bearer's 401 is still purged, and nothing is handed on. The `main.tsx` boot order is unchanged (no edit there).

<details><summary>Layer table, before and after (showcase, built console, 3 loads x 2 pages x 2 postures)</summary>

Method, the same before and after: `pnpm` turbo build of the showcase closure and `@object-ui/console` in this tree, then `packages/console/build-dist.sh`, served by `objectstack dev --fresh` from `examples/app-showcase` on a private port. Headless Chromium 1440x900, a new context per load, Resource Timing from navigation to network idle plus 3 s. Layer = 1 + the deepest layer of any request that ended before it started. That is chain depth, so it counts client render gaps too. cold = session cookie only: no Bearer, no stored language, no seed (the card's posture). warm = cookie + the sign-in Bearer. Before: `origin/main` 92121196. Its boot files are byte-identical to this branch's base d76d57ab; the commits between them touch only `ApprovalsInboxPage`. After: this branch at 58cd3111. Shared 4-core box, so times are shared-box ms.

| page / posture | chain depth before | after | me/localization before | after | get-session before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| list cold | 13 / 13 / 13 | 10 / 11 / 12 | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 | L3 (after me/localization) | L1 (parse time) |
| record cold | 13 / 14 / 14 | 13 / 13 / 14 | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 | L3 | L1 |
| list warm | 13 / 12 / 13 | 12 / 8 / 11 | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 | L1 | L1 |
| record warm | 12 / 14 / 13 | 11 / 12 / 11 | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 | L1 | L1 |

Dependency chain to the first list data, cold: before, the hops were parse-time reads -> seed localization -> get-session -> meta/app -> bundle -> meta/view -> data (7). After, they are parse-time reads + get-session -> seed localization -> meta/app -> bundle -> meta/view -> data (6). The permission/app group now waits on the seed race (the mount gate), as it already did in the warm posture, and no longer waits on get-session.

Signed-out visitor, after: 3 loads of the list URL with no cookie each sent `get-session` x1 (parse time, cookie) and landed on `/login` with the password field drawn. Before, the code also sent x1 (`AuthProvider` alone; no token meant no parse-time request). An intermediate build of this branch that handed on only a 200 no-user body measured x3 here, which is why the 401 is handed on as signed out.
</details>

## Tests

- `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx`: the old pin `does not share once the request has settled` pinned exactly the branch this removes (two requests), so it is replaced. One request when the seed settled before the mount, with a CONTROL that the seed is cached before any render (the locale before first paint). CONTROL: the hand-off is spent once, so a later mount asks. CONTROL: an unauthenticated seed answer is not handed over. CONTROL: an answer asked for the previous owner is not handed over.
- `ui/apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx`: a boot read answered by the hand-off still reads again after a write to the user's own row.
- `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/sessionCheckBootDedup.test.tsx`, new describe `no stored token: the cookie session is asked at parse time and handed on`. It covers six things:
  - The cookie question goes out in the same parse pass, with no Authorization header.
  - It is byte-equal to the preflight's own ask.
  - End to end: one get-session, signed in, the protected route renders, and the token is synced.
  - A 200 null answer is handed on as signed out: one get-session and the sign-in fallback.
  - A 401 UNAUTHENTICATED is handed on the same way.
  - CONTROLs: a non-OK answer hands nothing on and the protected route waits for `AuthProvider`'s own read; a token stored since the question is not answered by it; with a Bearer, a 401 is still purged and nothing is handed on.
- `authPreflightCredentials-12892.test.ts`: the no-token CONTROL now pins the cookie question (no Authorization header, nothing purged, slot token null).

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- Affected files under the verify lock on 58cd3111 (the product code and tests as pushed; the last commit adds only the changeset): `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the 13 console tests that import the boot modules, plus `languageSeed.test.ts`, `LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx`, all of `packages/auth/src`, `http-inflight.test.ts` and `anonSeedScope-5746`. `Test Files 65 passed (65)`, `Tests 641 passed (641)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: both `Done`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- eslint over the 9 touched ts/tsx files: exit 0. The 24 warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in `createAuthClient.ts`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` (derived): 171 passed, 2 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.
- Ablation: none run. The pins' red direction is the pre-change behaviour, measured on the built console in the table above (me/localization 2, get-session at L3), and the replaced settled-not-shared pin asserted exactly that pre-change count of 2.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Fixture triage: `blocked storage: no parse-time request` spied on `Storage.prototype.getItem`, which this test environment's `localStorage` does not reach. Before this change the script's no-token early return made it pass regardless. With the cookie question it went red, so it now spies on the window's `localStorage` accessor, and it asserts that the access really throws before it asserts that nothing is sent.
- The `Done when` of the card is not met by this slice (items 1 and 3 remain), hence `Refs`. The area files items 1 and 3 and the intermittent duplicate list-data read as child cards.
- In the cold posture the pre-mount gate now also waits for the parse-time cookie `get-session` (already true for the Bearer posture). It normally settles before the bundle has evaluated, and the bundle evaluation itself takes 500+ ms.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `ui/apps/console/src/lib/auth-preflight.ts` (`handOnCookieSession`, the 401 branch of `askSession`); `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` (`takePreflightSession`, the null-token arm); `ui/apps/console/src/languageSeed.ts` (`takeSettledSeedAnswer`, the spent flag).

Two minutes: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/sessionCheckBootDedup.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx`. Expect both files green, 31 + 8 tests.
